title: Privacy & cookies
intro: Handball Fantasy is a personal project, with no official ties to the LNH or the Daikin StarLigue, built and hosted on a non-commercial basis. This page explains what data is collected, why, and which cookies are used.

data.title: Data we collect
data.intro: When you create an account, we store:

items.email: your email address (your login, never shared)
items.password: your password, never stored in plain text (hashed with bcrypt)
items.name: the first name/nickname shown in the app
items.favoritePlayer: your favorite player, if you choose to set one (optional)
items.homeClub: the handball club you're from or play for, if you add one — optional, editable anytime, visible to the other members of your leagues

data.gameDataNote: Playing the game also generates game data: squads, lineups, leagues, points, history — needed for the game itself to work, and never used for anything else.

items.analytics: no audience analytics tool (Google Analytics or similar)
items.resale: no reselling or sharing of data with third parties

cookies.title: Cookies used
cookies.intro: This site only uses technical/functional cookies, strictly necessary for it to work — no consent is required for this type of cookie (CNIL recommendation), and no other cookie is set.

activeLeague.role: Remembers your active league if you're in several

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can request access to or correction of your data at any time, and delete your account yourself from My account → Danger zone (immediate, permanent deletion). For anything else, contact us via the support page.
